definitions.explanation: A journey in one direction only, as opposed to a round trip.

examples.japanese: {片道|かたみち}{切符|きっぷ}を{買|か}った。
{東京|とうきょう}から{大阪|おおさか}まで{片道|かたみち}3{時間|じかん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes 3 hours one way from Tokyo to Osaka.

examples.japanese: {片道|かたみち}の{料金|りょうきん}はいくらですか。
examples.english: How much is the one-way fare?

notes:
{片道|かたみち} refers to travel in one direction only.

Common expressions:
- {片道|かたみち}{切符|きっぷ} (one-way ticket)
- {片道|かたみち}{料金|りょうきん} (one-way fare)
- {片道|かたみち}〜{時間|じかん} (~ hours one way)

Opposite:
- {往復|おうふく} (round trip)
- {往復|おうふく}{切符|きっぷ} (round-trip ticket)

The kanji {片|かた} means 'one side' or 'half,' indicating only half of a round trip.
